decisions.reason: As a lightly promoted component-type innovation, the low-noise burner is likely to be cut if its sales stayed below aspiration and management wants to redeploy resources to the stronger heater lines.
Because it had its own page and fits the firm's infrared heating competence, management would likely give this plaque heater more time unless results clearly fell short of comparable offerings.
This luminous radiant heater looks more like an exploratory variant with limited visible commitment, so a modest shortfall versus aspiration would make it a candidate for withdrawal.
With two very similar gas-fired infrared tube heater products in the launch cohort, management is likely to prune the weaker one after a few years of market feedback.
The standard gas infrared plaque heater appears to be a core, baseline product in the new range, so organisational slack and portfolio fit support keeping it on the market.
As another low-prominence tube heater overlapping with Product D, it is the most exposed to problemistic search and line rationalisation if performance has been only middling.
